1.title: Move green cube to right tray
1.say: Pick up the small green cube. Place it in the front right corner of the right clear tray.
placements: small green cube → inside the right clear tray, front right corner pocket as seen from above (in the video: right tray, corner closest to the camera on the right side)
watch_for: if the right tray is empty, the suction tip did not seal on the flat top
if another colour is in the right tray, you picked up the wrong cube
1.check_yourself: It should look like the small green cube sits in the front right corner of the right clear tray and three small cubes stay in the left tray.
1.safety: Keep your hands clear of the moving arm.

2.title: Move blue cube to right tray
2.say: Pick up the small blue cube. Place it in the front left corner of the right clear tray.
placements: small blue cube → inside the right clear tray, front left corner pocket as seen from above (in the video: right tray, corner closest to the camera on the left side)
watch_for: if the blue cube is tipped over, the tip touched the edge instead of the centre
if the green cube moved, the arm bumped it on the way past
2.check_yourself: It should look like the green and blue cubes sit in the right clear tray and two small cubes stay in the left tray.
2.safety: Keep your hands clear of the moving arm.

3.title: Move yellow cube to right tray
3.say: Pick up the small yellow cube. Place it in the back right corner of the right clear tray.
placements: small yellow cube → inside the right clear tray, back right corner pocket as seen from above (in the video: right tray, corner farthest from the camera on the right side)
watch_for: if the yellow cube lands outside the pocket, the arm released it too high
if you see only two cubes in the right tray, one fell off on the way
3.check_yourself: It should look like green and blue and yellow cubes sit in the right clear tray and one small cube stays in the left tray.
3.safety: Keep your hands clear of the moving arm.

4.title: Move red cube to right tray
4.say: Pick up the small red cube. Place it in the back left corner of the right clear tray.
placements: small red cube → inside the right clear tray, back left corner pocket as seen from above (in the video: right tray, corner farthest from the camera on the left side)
watch_for: if the red cube covers another cube, it went to the wrong corner
if the red cube falls over, the tip was not centred on the top
4.check_yourself: It should look like all four small cubes sit in the four corners of the right clear tray and the left tray is empty.
4.safety: Keep your hands clear of the moving arm.

5.title: Return green cube to left tray
5.say: Pick up the small green cube. Place it in the front right corner of the left clear tray.
placements: small green cube → inside the left clear tray, front right corner pocket as seen from above (in the video: left tray, corner closest to the camera on the right side)
watch_for: if the green cube stays in the right tray, the suction did not lift it
if it lands in the wrong tray, check left from right from where you stand
5.check_yourself: It should look like the small green cube sits in the left clear tray and three small cubes stay in the right clear tray.
5.safety: Keep your hands clear of the moving arm.

6.check_yourself: It should look like the green and blue cubes sit in the left clear tray and two small cubes stay in the right clear tray.
